title: Exact finite enumeration to certificate
obligation: Exhaust a precisely bounded finite search space and preserve enough evidence to replay completeness and each accepted or rejected object.
rejection_policy: Reject an enumeration whose carrier, bound, equivalence relation, or pruning rule is implicit.
Reject completeness claims when skipped cases cannot be reconstructed from a proof-producing reduction.
Reject asymptotic or unbounded conclusions inferred from a finite screen.
mathcert_route: replay generation and pruning under exact arithmetic
verify count, witness digest, and completeness scope
claim_boundary: A complete bounded enumeration certifies only the stated finite range. It does not establish the corresponding unbounded conjecture.
